install.//: Expo SDK 57 suggests typescript ~6.0.3, but the monorepo is pinned to 5.x: ts-jest@29 declares peer typescript '>=4.3 <6' and @nestjs/cli@11 pins 5.7.3, so bumping to 6 would break the backend and shared test suites. One TS version across all workspaces matters more than matching Expo's suggestion, and mobile typechecks clean on 5.9.x. Revisit when ts-jest supports TS 6.

autolinking.//: Google Sign-In autolinks on BOTH platforms as of 2026-07-30. It was previously excluded on `apple`, and that exclusion is exactly what silently broke iOS sign-in: it removed ExpoAdapterGoogleSignIn, whose only job is the GoogleSignInAppDelegate subscriber that forwards the OAuth callback to GIDSignIn.handle(url). Without it the sheet opened, the user granted access, the callback was never delivered, and GIDSignIn reported kGIDSignInErrorCodeCanceled — which this app maps to 'cancelled', the one path that shows NO error. Symptom: a spinner, then the same screen, no message, no user created. The AppCheckCore → GoogleUtilities/RecaptchaInterop static-linkage pod failure that originally motivated the exclusion is now fixed properly in the Podfile by plugins/withGoogleSignInPods.js. IF YOU EVER EXCLUDE THIS AGAIN: scope it to `apple`, never top-level — expo-modules-autolinking applies a top-level exclude to every platform, which also strips RNGoogleSignin from Android and crashes startup with "TurboModuleRegistry.getEnforcing('RNGoogleSignin') could not be found".
